subject: general
question: Which of the following materials is used as a binding agent in organic brake linings?
solution:
The correct answer is __Resin.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Resin__ is widely used as a binding agent in organic brake linings.
 
• It helps to hold the composite materials together and provides structural integrity to the brake lining.
 
• Organic brake linings are primarily made of fibers, fillers, and resins to provide friction and durability.
 
• Resin allows for effective heat dissipation and ensures the brake lining performs consistently under various conditions.
 
• It also helps in minimizing wear and tear of the braking system components.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Metal powder:**

 
 
• Metal powders are added to brake linings to improve heat resistance and enhance friction.
 
• However, they are not the primary binding agent.
 
 
 
• **Cotton:**
 
 
• Cotton fibers may be used in some cases to reinforce brake linings.
 
• They are not suitable as a binding agent since they lack adhesive properties.
 
 
 
• **Rubber:**
 
 
• Rubber is sometimes used as an additive to improve the flexibility of brake linings.
 
• It is not the primary material for binding purposes.
